diagnostics.message: :output.custom_role_id: explicit depends_on of :resource.google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles is redundant — already implied by attribute references

output.custom_role_id has an explicit depends_on on google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles, but its value expression ({for role_id, role in google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles : ...}) already references that resource, so Terraform infers the same ordering implicitly.
